TassadarStaticCharge.name: Static Charge
TassadarStaticCharge.description: Quest: Heroes hit by Shock Ray permanently increases its damage by 5 and grants 33% Resonance Beam charge. Maximum of 200 bonus damage.

TassadarPsionicStormPsiInfusion.name: Psi-Infusion
TassadarPsionicStormPsiInfusion.description: Increases the range of Psionic Storm by 33%. Each non-Structure enemy hit by Psionic Storm restores 0.5 Mana, increased to 5 against Heroes.

TassadarKhaydarinAmulet.name: Khaydarin Amulet
TassadarKhaydarinAmulet.description: Quest: Resonance Beam charges 50% faster. Reward: After Resonance Beam has been fully charged for 80 seconds, it bounces to hit 1 additional target for 75% damage, prioritizing Heroes. TassadarInduction.name: Induction
TassadarInduction.description: Tassadar gains 10% increased Movement Speed. Casting Shock Ray increases this bonus to 30% for 3 seconds.

TassadarElectricFence.name: Electric Fence
TassadarElectricFence.description: Force Wall deals 92 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies and Slows them by 35%.

TassadarPlasmaShield.name: Plasma Shield
TassadarPlasmaShield.description: While Resonance Beam is fully charged, gain a Shield equal to 3% of max Health every second, stacking up to 12%.

TassadarBeamAlignment.name: Beam Alignment
TassadarBeamAlignment.description: While Resonance Beam is fully charged, Shock Ray's cooldown refreshes 100% faster and its Slow duration is increased to 4 seconds. Passive: Reduce the Mana cost of Shock Ray from 55 to 40.

TassadarPsionicEcho.name: Psionic Echo
TassadarPsionicEcho.description: Casting Psionic Storm causes your next Shock Ray within 3 seconds to only cost 30 Mana and create a Psionic Storm on the first enemy Hero hit.

TassadarArcDischarge.name: Arc Discharge
TassadarArcDischarge.description: When Resonance Beam is fully charged, Tassadar's Basic Attack range is increased by 1 and its next instance of damage also creates a Psionic Storm on the target. This effect has a 20 second cooldown that decays twice as fast while Resonance Beam is fully charged.

TassadarHeroicAbilityArchon.name: Archon
TassadarHeroicAbilityArchon.description: Tassadar transforms into an Archon, gaining a Shield equal to 25% of his maximum Health and empowering Resonance Beam. Lasts for 12 seconds. TassadarHeroicAbilityBlackHole.name: Black Hole
TassadarHeroicAbilityBlackHole.description: After a 0.5 second cast, create a Black Hole that travels in a long line. Enemy Heroes within the Black Hole's area are quickly pulled towards its center. Touching the center deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Stuns the target for 1.25 seconds.

TassadarFeedback.name: Feedback
TassadarFeedback.description: When an enemy Hero is affected by Psionic Storm, Resonance Beam's Slow is increased to 50% and it reduces Physical Armor by 25.

TassadarShadowWalk.name: Shadow Walk
TassadarShadowWalk.description: Tassadar becomes Stealthed and Unrevealable, but cannot attack or use Abilities for 1.5 seconds. While this effect is active, gain 40% increased Movement Speed and 35 Armor. Can be cast while Channeling Shock Ray.

TassadarOracle.name: Oracle
TassadarOracle.description: Passive: While stationary, gain 30 Spell Armor for 0.75 seconds and restore 12 (+4% per level) Health a second. Activate to Channel for up to 4 seconds, revealing a gradually increasing area anywhere on the map.

TassadarThermalLance.name: Thermal Lance
TassadarThermalLance.description: Shock Ray deals an additional 8% of maximum Health as damage to the first Hero it hits.

TassadarExecutorsWill.name: Executor's Will
TassadarExecutorsWill.description: Activate to gain full Resonance Beam charge, 20% Spell Power, and cause Basic and Heroic Ability cooldowns to regenerate 25% faster. This effect lasts as long as Resonance Beam remains at full charge.

TassadarMasteryTwilightArchon.name: Twilight Archon
TassadarMasteryTwilightArchon.description: Basic Attacks while in Archon form increase its duration by 2 seconds.

TassadarKugelblitz.name: Kugelblitz
TassadarKugelblitz.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Black Hole's center have their Armor reduced by 20 for 3 seconds and have a Psionic Storm created at their location.

TassadarMasteryForceBarrier.name: Force Barrier
TassadarMasteryForceBarrier.description: Increase the duration of Force Wall by 0.5 seconds, its range by 50%, and reduce its cooldown by 10 seconds.

TassadarKhalasGift.name: Khala's Gift
TassadarKhalasGift.description: Gain 4% Spell Power for yourself and each nearby ally Hero, up to 20% total Spell Power. Your total bonus is shared with all contributing allies.
